pairs.question: Quare igitur tanto agmine atque animis incedit?
pairs.answer: Quia secundae res mire sunt vitiis optentui, quibus labefactis, quam formidatus est, tam contemnetur.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a rhetorical question (why does Sulla advance with such force and confidence?) and answers it himself with the directly following Quia-clause. Answer ends at the first full stop; the cut drops the following digressive sentence beginning 'Nisi forte specie concordiae et pacis...', which elaborates rather than answers. Section marker '24' stripped from the start.
